title: Set up Supabase database schema and RLS policies
description: Create the database tables (profiles and comparison_sessions) with proper schema structure and implement Row Level Security policies for user data isolation
details: Execute the SQL schema creation scripts to establish the profiles table with TEXT id field for Clerk user_id, encrypted API key fields, and the comparison_sessions table with foreign key relationships. Implement RLS policies that use JWT claims to ensure users can only access their own data. Create necessary indexes for performance optimization, particularly on user_id fields for session queries.
test_strategy: Test RLS policies by creating test users and verifying data isolation. Validate that users cannot access other users' profiles or sessions. Test database constraints and foreign key relationships.

title: Integrate Clerk authentication with Next.js App Router
description: Set up Clerk.js authentication system with Next.js App Router, configure middleware, and create user profile synchronization with Supabase
details: Install and configure Clerk.js SDK for Next.js App Router. Set up authentication middleware to protect routes and extract user claims. Create sign-in/sign-up components using Clerk's pre-built components. Implement user profile synchronization logic that creates/updates profiles table records when users authenticate, using the Clerk user_id as the primary key. Configure JWT token handling for Supabase RLS integration.
test_strategy: Test authentication flows including sign-up, sign-in, and sign-out. Verify JWT token extraction and user profile creation in Supabase. Test protected route access and middleware functionality.

title: Build main comparison interface with shadcn/ui components
description: Create the dual-panel comparison interface with model selection dropdowns, system prompt input, markdown editor, and results display areas
details: Implement the main comparison page using shadcn/ui components. Create two side-by-side panels (Panel A and Panel B) with model selection dropdowns for OpenAI (GPT-5, o3-mini, gpt-4o) and Google Gemini (2.5 pro, flash, flash lite) models. Add a system prompt textarea and integrate a markdown WYSIWYG editor for user content input. Implement markdown rendering components for displaying LLM outputs. Add loading states, error handling UI, and a compare/generate button with proper form validation.
test_strategy: Test UI responsiveness across different screen sizes. Validate form inputs and dropdown selections. Test markdown editor functionality and output rendering. Verify loading states and error message displays.

title: Implement LLM API integration and session management
description: Create API routes for LLM communication, implement encrypted API key management, and build session saving/loading functionality
details: Build Next.js API routes or Server Actions to handle LLM requests. Implement secure API key retrieval from user profiles with encryption/decryption. Create parallel request handlers for OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs using their respective SDKs. Implement session saving functionality that stores comparison inputs, selected models, and outputs to the comparison_sessions table. Build session history retrieval and loading capabilities. Add proper error handling for API failures, rate limits, and invalid API keys.
test_strategy: Test API integrations with both OpenAI and Google Gemini endpoints. Verify API key encryption/decryption and secure storage. Test session saving and loading functionality. Validate error handling for various failure scenarios including invalid API keys and rate limits.
